title: Compatible roofs for restriction of resolved cosimplicial module complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $h:Y'\to Y$ a scheme morphism, and $a\in\mathbf Z$. In the categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $A_\bullet$ and $B_\bullet$ be augmented cosimplicial diagrams of cochain complexes: complexes $A_{-1},A_0,A_1,\ldots$ on $Y$ and $B_{-1},B_0,B_1,\ldots$ on $Y'$, with augmentation, cofaces and codegeneracies that are chain maps and satisfy the augmented cosimplicial identities. Every complex is zero in degrees $j<a$. Suppose $b:h^{-1}A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$ is a morphism of these augmented diagrams, where inverse image is the exact module inverse image of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Choose on $Y,Y'$ the bounded functorial injective resolutions $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to I$ and $\eta':\mathrm{id}\to I'$ of [lem-weil-pbc-functorial-bounded-injective-resolution]; their existence hypotheses hold by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian, lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-functorial-injective-embedding].

There is a zigzag of actual morphisms of augmented cosimplicial complexes of $\Lambda$-modules
$$\Gamma(Y,I(A_\bullet))\xrightarrow{u}\Gamma(Y',I'(h^{-1}I(A_\bullet)))\xleftarrow{v}\Gamma(Y',I'(h^{-1}A_\bullet))\xrightarrow{w}\Gamma(Y',I'(B_\bullet)).$$
The map $u$ is restriction on sections to $h^{-1}I(A_\bullet)$ followed by $\eta'$; $v=\Gamma I'(h^{-1}\eta_{A_\bullet})$; and $w=\Gamma I'(b)$. Every arrow commutes with every coface, codegeneracy and augmentation, and every displayed column has internal degrees at least $a$. Each column of $v$, including the augmentation column, is a quasi-isomorphism. Under the identifications of [def-kun-rgamma-unbounded], the columnwise roof $wv^{-1}u$ represents
$$R\Gamma(Y,A_q)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}_h}R\Gamma(Y',h^{-1}A_q)\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(b_q)}R\Gamma(Y',B_q)\quad(q\ge-1).$$
The alternating coface differentials and the total differential $\delta+(-1)^q d$ therefore give a zigzag of actual augmented double-complex maps. The assertion concerns a compatible roof of diagrams, not independent choices of derived morphisms in individual columns.

source.place: Tag 0141, lemma-functorial-injective-resolutions and remark-match; diagramwise application to the unit of exact module inverse image. The displayed common-resolution roof makes the change-of-site comparison precise.

proof.text: For each of the two small étale sites, the category of constant-Λ module sheaves is Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]. Thus it has functorial injective embeddings by [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-functorial-injective-embedding]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-functorial-bounded-injective-resolution] simultaneously to the augmented cosimplicial complexes A_• and B_• and to every coface, codegeneracy, and augmentation map. Naturality of the resolution transformation gives augmented cosimplicial complexes I(A_•) and I'(B_•), with termwise injectives and the same lower bound a; [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist] makes their bounded-below injective columns K-injective.

Exactness of h^{-1} on Λ-module sheaves is [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], so applying h^{-1} termwise preserves the complexes, their augmentations, all cosimplicial identities, and the vanishing in degrees below a; being exact, h^{-1} commutes with cohomology of complexes, so h^{-1}η_{A_q}:h^{-1}A_q→h^{-1}I(A_q) is a quasi-isomorphism for every q≥−1. Applying the functorial resolution I' of [lem-weil-pbc-functorial-bounded-injective-resolution] gives the chain map I'(h^{-1}η_{A_q}):I'(h^{-1}A_q)→I'(h^{-1}I(A_q)), natural in q. By naturality of η', I'(h^{-1}η_{A_q})∘η'_{h^{-1}A_q}=η'_{h^{-1}I(A_q)}∘h^{-1}η_{A_q}. In this square the two vertical sides η' and the top side h^{-1}η are quasi-isomorphisms, hence so is I'(h^{-1}η_{A_q}) by two-out-of-three, including the augmentation column q=−1. Both I'(h^{-1}A_q) and I'(h^{-1}I(A_q)) are bounded-below complexes of injectives, hence K-injective [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]; with the augmentations η'_{h^{-1}A_q} and η'_{h^{-1}I(A_q)}∘h^{-1}η_{A_q} they are two K-injective resolutions of h^{-1}A_q, and the square says that I'(h^{-1}η_{A_q}) is a comparison between them over h^{-1}A_q. By [lem-kun-rgamma-unbounded-well-defined], taking sections over Y' gives an isomorphism in D(Λ); thus each column of v=ΓI'(h^{-1}η_{A_•}) is a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of Λ-modules.

source.place: Tag 04JC, exactness of inverse image on module sheaves; combined with derived.tex Tag 0141 naturality

proof.text: For a Λ-module sheaf F on Y, the restriction map on sections Γ(Y,F)→Γ(Y',h^{-1}F) is the component at the final object Y of the unit F→h_*h^{-1}F of the adjunction h^{-1}⊣h_* of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] (3), using (h_*G)(Y)=G(Y'×_YY)=G(Y') from the formula for h_* there; it is Λ-linear and natural in F. Applied termwise to F=I(A_q)^j it gives, for every q≥−1, a chain map Γ(Y,I(A_q))→Γ(Y',h^{-1}I(A_q)) natural in every coface, codegeneracy and augmentation. Composing with Γ(Y',η'_{h^{-1}I(A_q)}) gives u; since η' is natural, u is a morphism of augmented cosimplicial complexes of Λ-modules.

source.place: Tag 0141, functoriality of the resolution maps; module-sheaf section restriction

proof.text: The given diagram morphism b:h^{-1}A_•→B_• is a morphism of augmented cosimplicial complexes. Functoriality of I' sends it to I'(b):I'(h^{-1}A_•)→I'(B_•), and taking sections gives w. Consequently w commutes with every coface, codegeneracy, and augmentation. The same observation applied to η' shows that all three displayed arrows are actual maps of augmented diagrams, rather than independently chosen derived morphisms.

source.place: Tag 0141, functoriality on morphisms of complexes and diagrams

proof.text: The resolution functor preserves the lower bound by [lem-weil-pbc-functorial-bounded-injective-resolution], while exact h^{-1} preserves zero terms below a. Hence every column in u, v, and w, including the augmentation column, is internally concentrated in degrees at least a. The alternating coface maps and the chain maps above therefore form a double-complex zigzag with total differential δ+(-1)^q d; commutation with the cofaces gives genuine maps of augmented total complexes.

source.place: Tag 0141, bounded-below functorial resolutions; alternating-complex construction

proof.text: Here res_h:RΓ(Y,K)→RΓ(Y',h^{-1}K) is the restriction map induced by the inverse-image/direct-image unit of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]: for a K-injective resolution K→I on Y and a K-injective resolution h^{-1}I→J on Y' (h^{-1}K→h^{-1}I→J is a K-injective resolution of h^{-1}K since h^{-1} is exact), it is the composite Γ(Y,I)→Γ(Y,h_*h^{-1}I)=Γ(Y',h^{-1}I)→Γ(Y',J) of the unit and the resolution map; by [lem-kun-rgamma-unbounded-well-defined] this is independent of the resolutions in D(Λ). By Step 1, η_{A_q}:A_q→I(A_q) is a K-injective resolution [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], so Γ(Y,I(A_q)) represents RΓ(Y,A_q) [def-kun-rgamma-unbounded]; η'_{h^{-1}I(A_q)} is a K-injective resolution of h^{-1}I(A_q), so by Step 3 the column u_q is exactly the composite defining res_h with I=I(A_q), J=I'(h^{-1}I(A_q)), its target representing RΓ(Y',h^{-1}A_q) through the resolution η'_{h^{-1}I(A_q)}∘h^{-1}η_{A_q}. Step 2 identifies, through v_q, this target with the representative Γ(Y',I'(h^{-1}A_q)) coming from η'_{h^{-1}A_q}, by the canonical isomorphism of [lem-kun-rgamma-unbounded-well-defined]; hence v_q^{-1}u_q represents res_h. Finally I'(b_q) is a chain map between the K-injective resolutions η'_{h^{-1}A_q} and η'_{B_q} lying over b_q (naturality of η'), so w_q=ΓI'(b_q) represents RΓ(b_q), the action of RΓ on morphisms computed by lifts to K-injective resolutions, unique up to homotopy [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Thus w_qv_q^{-1}u_q represents RΓ(Y,A_q)→RΓ(Y',h^{-1}A_q)→RΓ(Y',B_q) for every q≥−1, with one common choice of resolutions and all cosimplicial compatibilities retained.
